reason: Baseline attempt-002 (68d8a597) failed during compilation: rustc, LLVM and cl.exe ran out of commit memory (os error 1455) under Cargo's default parallelism on an 8-thread host. This amendment limits Cargo to 2 parallel jobs for both revisions. It is declared before any attempt of either revision executed the adapter; no detector outcome of either revision has been observed. Baseline attempts 001-002 remain recorded under the original predeclaration; new attempts (baseline 003 onward, candidate 001 onward) are governed by this amendment.
not_claimed: Not claimed: that the build will now succeed, or that binaries are identical to a build with other parallelism (debug MSVC builds are not expected to be bit-reproducible). --jobs is Cargo's scheduling of compilation units; the toolchain, target, profile, features, lock file, corpus, policy, timeout, outcome contract, grouping and attempt rule are unchanged, and the original predeclaration file is not edited.
